items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes (18, 1, 10 µL mix) handled by p20 within its range, labware loaded with the specified labels, and all simulator checks pass.
Every well uses its own pick_up_tip()/drop_tip() pair in all three loops; tip_before_aspirate, no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks pass.
The steps run in the specified order with the specified quantities (18 µL, then 1 µL colony with mix(3, 10) after dispensing, then 1 µL primer), and the final comment records seal and thermocycling.
The loop aspirates 18 µL from master_mix_reservoir A1 and dispenses it into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells; the pcr_plate end_state check passes.
The loops move 1 µL from colony_plate[name] and 1 µL from primer_plate[name] into the matching pcr_plate well with p20; the end-state checks pass.
The final protocol.comment records sealing and the full program: 98C 30 s, 30 cycles of 98C 10 s, 60C 30 s and 72C 30 s, then 72C 2 min and a 4C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes every measured check. It uses a fresh p20 tip for each well, follows the quantities and order in the task, and records the seal and thermocycling program in a comment.
